pages.readingHtml:
Allied Health & Clinical Careers

Undergraduate kinesiology coursework serves as the primary academic prerequisite track for graduate education in physical therapy (DPT), occupational therapy (OTD), physician assistant (PA) studies, and athletic training (MSAT).

Performance and Wellness Careers

Outside clinical medicine, kinesiologists work in strength and conditioning (CSCS), clinical exercise physiology, tactical human performance, and corporate health management.
